overloads.semanticRole: Sets, for the current process, the tab/entry order of the current (or specified) form page to the order of valid focusable objects listed in objectNames.

constraints: Only objects with the focusable property are considered valid entry-order candidates (the Tabbable object property is ignored by this command); invalid objects in objectNames are simply skipped at runtime.
A form page includes page 0 objects and inherited form objects.
This command does not set the first focused object at runtime; use GOTO OBJECT in the form's On Load event for that.
For a subform, the entry order must be set by calling this command from within the subform's own context, not from the parent form.
